title: Tensor compatibility of a transported common-coordinate comparison
statement:
Let $C$ be a Grothendieck abelian symmetric monoidal closed coefficient category, with tensor additive in each variable, functorial flat resolutions, and every etale inverse-image functor preserving flat objects. Write $D_C(T)$ for the ordinary unbounded derived category of $C$-valued sheaves on the small etale site of a scheme $T$, with its canonical derived tensor. This includes $C=\operatorname{ModuleCat}(A)$ for any commutative ring $A$, with the operations of [def-kun-derived-tensor] and [lem-kun-inverse-image-monoidal]. Let $f:X\to Y$ be any morphism of schemes, $L,K\in D_C(Y)$, $B\in D_C(X)$ and $e:B\simeq f^*L$. Put $U=f^*$, $R=p_1^*$, $V=p_2^*$ for the self-product, $Q=UK$ and $M=B\otimes Q$. Let $\kappa:RU\simeq VU$ be the canonical comparison obtained from the two pullback composition isomorphisms, and $\delta_U,\delta_R,\delta_V$ the canonical tensor comparisons. Define $c_B=R(e);\kappa_L;V(e^{-1})$ (coefficientCoordinate). Define $e_K=(e\otimes1_Q);\delta_U(L,K)^{-1}$ and $c_M=R(e_K);\kappa_{L\otimes K};V(e_K^{-1})$ (tensorCoordinate). Then
$$ c_M;\delta_V(B,Q)=\delta_R(B,Q);(c_B\otimes\kappa_K). $$
No self-symmetry hypothesis on $L$, properness, direct image, projection formula or scalar trace is assumed. The module also records the canonical tensor split $d=\delta_R(B,Q);(RB\otimes\kappa_K)$ and the cyclic isomorphism $(E\otimes VQ)\otimes VB\simeq V(B\otimes Q)\otimes E$, obtained by associating, swapping VQ with VB, undoing the V tensor comparison, and swapping E past V(B tensor Q). These are composites of the same canonical tensor data, with no asserted projection compatibility.

source.place: Second triangle: transport the common coefficient through the two pullbacks and their tensor comparisons, before using even self-symmetry.

proof.text: Use the existing native theorem derivedSquareUpperStarIso_hom_tensor for the canonical reversed self-product square. This is monoidality of the two pullback composition comparisons, with exactly the general coefficient hypotheses of the Lean theorem; its module-coefficient specialization is the tensor compatibility in lem-kun-derived-pullback-composition-monoidal. Precompose by R of the inverse f tensor comparison. Functoriality and inverse identities cancel R of the f tensor comparison.

Conjugate by e tensor the identity on Q and its inverse. Naturality of the R and V tensor comparisons moves these to R(e) tensor the identity and V(e inverse) tensor the identity. Functoriality of the right tensor factor and whisker exchange identify the composite with cB tensor kappa_K. The resulting full-tensor conjugation is cM by its definition. This is conjugate_tensor followed by the native square equation.

proof_origin.place: Canonical inverse-image tensor comparison in the common-coefficient part of the second triangle; fully proved by U4.

lean.statement:
theorem coordinateTensor {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (L K : _root_.DerivedCategory (Sheaf Y.smallEtaleTopology C))
    {B : _root_.DerivedCategory (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology C)}
    (e : B ≅ (upperStar C f).leftDerivedFunctor.obj L) :
    (tensorCoordinate C f L K e).hom ≫
        (leftDerivedUpperStarTensorIso C (pullback.snd f f) B
          ((upperStar C f).leftDerivedFunctor.obj K)).hom =
      (leftDerivedUpperStarTensorIso C (pullback.fst f f) B
        ((upperStar C f).leftDerivedFunctor.obj K)).hom ≫
        ((coefficientCoordinate C f L e).hom ⊗ₘ
          ((derivedSquareUpperStarIso C
            (CommSq.mk (pullback.condition (f := f) (g := f)).symm)).app K).hom)
